visuals: Golden, sun-baked plains in Andalusia, Southern Spain, with olive trees under a bright blue sky.
script: This country’s geography is full of surprises. In the south, the weather is often hot and dry.

visuals: Mist-covered, lush green forests in Asturias, Northern Spain, with damp ferns and mossy rocks.
script: While up north it’s cooler and wetter. That means you could sunbathe in one city and hike in foggy forests in another, all in the same week!

visuals: Snowy peaks of the Spanish Pyrenees Mountains with visible ski tracks on a crisp winter day.
script: Now for my favorite part… check out the Pyrenees Mountains! They stretch between Spain and France like a giant natural wall and are perfect for winter sports like skiing and snowboarding. Snowball fight, anyone?

visuals: A Spanish imperial eagle soaring over a dense Mediterranean pine forest.
script: And get this, soaring high over forest peaks is the Spanish imperial eagle. It’s a rare bird that lives in the wild and is known for its power and grace.

visuals: An Iberian lynx in the Spanish scrubland and pink flamingos in the Doñana National Park wetlands.
script: Speaking of wild, Spain is home to the Iberian lynx, one of the rarest wild cats in the world! You’ll also find flamingos chilling in the wetlands of Doñana National Park, striking their best pink poses.

visuals: A lively afternoon at the Plaza Mayor in Madrid, Spain, with people seated at outdoor café tables surrounded by historic red buildings.
script: Ready for some city buzz? What city has the oldest restaurant on Earth, according to Guinness? That’s Madrid! Spain’s lively capital right in the middle of the country!

visuals: The vibrant, mosaic-covered facade of Casa Batlló designed by Antoni Gaudí in the city of Barcelona, Spain.
script: But wait, there’s more… Barcelona is bursting with funky buildings made by a brilliant architect named Gaudí, they look like candy castles!

visuals: Flamenco dancer mid-spin with guitarists performing in the interior of a classic Spanish courtyard featuring colorful ceramic tilework (azulejos) in Seville.
script: And in Seville, flamenco fills the air with passionate music and stomping feet.

visuals: The historic stone facade of the University of Salamanca in Spain with a few students walking across the sunny plaza.
script: Now let’s chat languages. Besides Spanish, many people also speak Catalan, Basque, and Galician! Regional languages that help shape Spain’s amazing culture.

visuals: A vibrant street scene on the Gran Vía in Madrid, Spain, with pedestrians walking past iconic Belle Époque buildings.
script: Spain is home to about 47 million people! That’s roughly the same as California! Pretty cool, right?

visuals: A large, authentic pan of seafood paella with shrimp and mussels cooking over an open fire in a Spanish coastal village.
script: Yum alert! Paella is a mouthwatering rice dish often made with seafood or chicken. It’s a weekend favorite in many parts of Spain, especially in Valencia.

visuals: A cold glass of horchata de chufa served with a plate of fartons on a rustic wooden table in a traditional Valencian horchatería.
script: Want something sweet? Try horchata in the summer! It’s made from tiger nuts, which grow underground and aren’t really nuts at all! Tricky, huh?

visuals: Sun-drenched olive groves stretching across the rolling hills of Jaén, Spain, under a clear summer sky.
script: And don’t forget the grapes! Spain is one of the top olive oil makers in the world, and all those olives and grapes make for tasty meals, and legendary snacks at cafés and bars all across the land.

visuals: Close-up of a Spanish flamenco dancer's hands playing castanets during a performance.
script: Speaking of culture, flamenco is more than a dance! It tells stories with music, claps, and spinning dresses.

visuals: A traditional Spanish village festival at night, with strings of lanterns (farolillos) crossing the plaza and locals dancing.
script: Families and friends gather at festivals to dance their hearts out.

visuals: Spanish fans in a public square celebrating a victory, waving the red and yellow national flag of Spain.
script: In 2010, Spain celebrated big-time! Their men’s soccer team became world champions for the first time, and the whole country went wild with joy.

visuals: Spanish tennis legend Rafael Nadal mid-serve on a red clay court in a tournament.
script: Sports fans, cheer this: Rafael Nadal, king of the tennis court, is from Spain’s island of Mallorca.

visuals: Spanish soccer star Alexia Putellas celebrating on the pitch with a trophy.
script: And soccer superstar Alexia Putellas? She’s making waves in women’s soccer and has won major awards like the Ballon d’Or!

visuals: The town of Buñol, Spain, during the La Tomatina festival, with the street and participants covered in red tomato pulp.
script: Here’s a juicy surprise: every year in the town of Buñol, people have a massive tomato fight called La Tomatina. Talk about a food fling!
